seo.title: Legal notice | Awrea Paris
seo.description: Who publishes the Awrea Paris website, who hosts it, its VAT statement, made to order production and the texts that govern your purchases.

chapeau: This English translation is given for information. Only the French version of the legal notice is legally binding.

blocs.texte: The website www.awreaparis.com is published by Léane Soubrier, designer and founder of the Maison Awrea Paris, which she runs as a sole proprietorship. The information below is published in accordance with French Law No. 2004-575 of 21 June 2004 on confidence in the digital economy.

fiche.valeur: {{raisonSociale}}, sole proprietor (entrepreneuse individuelle, EI) under the micro-enterprise scheme
Vercel Inc., 440 N Barranca Ave #4133, Covina, CA 91723, United States

blocs.texte: VAT not applicable, article 293 B of the French General Tax Code.

The Maison falls under the VAT exemption scheme for small businesses (franchise en base de TVA). It does not charge VAT: the price shown for each piece is the price you pay, with only the delivery costs shown before the order added to it. The same statement appears in the summary of your order, in the email that confirms it and on every invoice.

Awrea Paris mainly offers standard models: each piece is shown on its page, in the sizes of the [size guide](/guide-des-tailles). Nothing is made in advance. The piece is made after your order is confirmed, within the production time shown on its page, in the bag and before payment.

A piece made to order in a standard size is not a personalised creation. For these standard models, you have the fourteen day right of withdrawal provided for by the French Consumer Code, under the conditions of the page [Right of withdrawal](/retractation).

Only a genuinely personalised creation, made to your measurements or to your specific requests, may be excluded from the right of withdrawal (article L221-28, 3° of the French Consumer Code). In that case, the Maison tells you so before you confirm the order.

For any complaint, first write to the Maison at {{email}}, giving your order number, the reason for your request and, if needed, photographs. The time limits for reporting a damaged parcel or a non conforming piece are set out in article 5 of the [terms and conditions of sale](/cgv#livraison), your guarantees in their [article 8](/cgv#garanties).
If your written complaint is not resolved, you may refer the matter free of charge to the consumer mediator on which the Maison depends, within one year of that complaint: {{mediateur}}.

The texts, photographs, videos, designs of the pieces, logos and layout of this site belong to Awrea Paris, except for the trademarks, logos and content of partners or authors, which remain their property. Any reproduction, representation, modification, adaptation, distribution or publication, even partial, without the written consent of the Maison is prohibited. It constitutes an infringement punishable under articles L335-2 et seq. of the French Intellectual Property Code, and engages the civil and criminal liability of its author.

Awrea Paris is a trademark filed with the INPI, the French intellectual property office, under number {{marque}}. Its name and logo may not be used without the written authorisation of the Maison. The details of these rules, and what remains permitted, are on the page [Intellectual property](/propriete-intellectuelle).

The Maison processes your personal data in accordance with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and the French Data Protection Act of 6 January 1978. The data collected, their purposes, how long they are kept and how to exercise your rights (access, rectification, erasure, objection, restriction, portability) are described in the [privacy policy](/confidentialite). Cookies and other trackers, and how to change your choices at any time, are described in the [cookie policy](/cookies). For any question: {{email}}.

The photographs of the pieces are, for now, provisional generated images, used until the photo shoots of the collection. Each one carries the mention “provisional image”. The portrait of the designer and the photographs of the Maison are the work of {{creditsPhotos}}.
To report unlawful content or an infringement of your rights, write to {{email}}, giving the address of the page and the nature of the content.

sections.titre: The texts that govern your purchases

blocs.texte: This legal notice says who publishes and hosts the site. The rules of your purchases are set by the terms and conditions of sale, which you accept with each order, and by the pages that detail them:

liste: [Terms and conditions of sale](/cgv): ordering, price, payment and delivery.
[Delivery and returns](/livraison-retours): production and delivery times, rates, tracking and returns.
[Right of withdrawal](/retractation): fourteen days to change your mind, and the online form.
[Legal guarantees](/cgv#garanties): the legal guarantee of conformity and the guarantee against hidden defects, in article 8 of the terms and conditions of sale.
[Complaints and mediation](/mentions-legales#mediation): whom to write to, and the free recourse to the consumer mediator.
[Privacy policy](/confidentialite): your personal data and your rights.
[Cookie policy](/cookies): the trackers of the site and your choices.
[Terms and conditions of use](/cgu): use of the site, the account and the assistant.
